reply.text:
That's one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I won't tell you whether it's normal or what to do about it. If the soreness is hanging around or getting worse, get it looked at. I'm happy to keep going on the training side once they've cleared you.

For your next workout, I need to check your program so I give you the right session rather than guess. Tell me which program you're running and I'll pull up where you are in it.
